sentence: This project studies how structures that unfold into useful 3D shapes change shape under external loads.
This project designs a network that stays secure and keeps working during disasters, when little normal infrastructure survives.
This project studies how polymer additives help perovskite materials repair defects and cracks at their grain boundaries.
This project builds a database of phonon properties of materials, with a web server and tools to browse and compare them.
This project builds molecular tools to work out parentage and compares mating behavior across three salamander species.
This project measures the mechanical forces inside living cells and tests whether changes in these forces alter how the cells produce proteins.
This project studies problems in statistics, such as analyzing high dimensional data and modeling the power grid.
This project studies how healthy plants, soils, and microbiomes support sustainable agricultural practices and food security.
This project carries out research in nanoscale science and engineering across chemistry, biology, medicine, and physics.
This project tries to find out how hibernating squirrels can go for months without eating or feeling hunger.
This project builds molecular tunnel junction devices and studies how charge moves through them.
This project builds lessons about microelectronics for a high school computer science course, adding sensors, output devices, and actuators to a robotics kit.
This project builds lesson plans that make immunology easier to teach and understand in college biology courses.
This project tests whether tiny lights can brightly light several particles held by light in a partial vacuum.
This project builds a way for robots to turn engineering documentation into manufacturing tasks and checks plans with a digital twin.
This project studies how rice farming practices and climate affect where and when arsenic is released from paddy soils into rice.
This project studies the basic particles of nature, including axions and monopoles, and looks for explanations of dark matter.
This project builds software that lets small computers near sensors run code for applications that must respond quickly.
This project studies how heat moves from gold nanoparticles into the liquid around them, in order to control their temperature.
